meta.title: Kotek, Drazan push for transparency as Portland and Salem-Keizer weigh school closures
meta.author: KATU News
meta.description:
Portland and Salem-Keizer school districts face major decisions that could lead to school closures and affect students, families, and neighborhoods.

Portland Public Schools (PPS) is considering closing up to 14 schools, and Salem-Keizer has proposed closing six, as both districts face declining enrollment and tight budgets.

State and local leaders, including Gov. Tina Kotek and State Sen. Christine Drazan of Canby, both of whom are gubernatorial candidates in the upcoming election, have been contacted by more than 300 Portland Public Schools parents this week, who are asking them to intervene.

Neighborhood schools are often seen as the heart of their communities, and concern is growing over the possible loss of these schools.
